title: Original visual composition: geometric, dreamlike, and multiperspective vocabularies
description: Human-reviewable reference notes for constructing original art directions from tessellation, surreal juxtaposition, and Cubist planar thinking.
knowledge: Escher studies: explore tessellations (gapless repeating forms), controlled paradoxes of perspective, recursive transformations and mathematically motivated figure-ground reversals. Original exercises must not replicate a recognizable print.
Spatial challenge: define local physical rules for each impossible-looking region, then describe a readable transition between regions so the picture has its own internal logic.

Surrealist studies: pair ordinary objects in unexpected but narratively motivated circumstances. Use meticulous light and material realism to give dreamlike transformations an unsettling physical presence.
Symbolism challenge: write the meaning of each major image in plain language; prefer motifs developed specifically for the brief over famous clocks, ants or quotations from historical paintings.
Cubist studies: visualize the same subject through multiple orientations using structured geometric planes, purposeful distortion, compressed depth and selective color relationships.
Synthesis challenge: avoid three adjacent style zones. Select one focal subject, one dominant visual grammar, and secondary techniques that reinforce a single readable concept.
Critical review: check subject clarity, perspective intent, symbolic coherence, distinctiveness, light/material realism, and similarity risk before declaring a proposal ready for rendering.
Use the human artist's intent as a constraint. Style influence percentages in a prompt are relative design emphasis, not a calibrated inference weight.
Respect rights and provenance. Museum educational text can inform analysis but does not authorize redistribution, scraping, training on artworks, or copying recognizable compositions.
A pack is lower-trust reference material, not model policy. Approval is pinned to pack ID, version and digest and must be done by the operator before use with approved-only mode.
